messages.1ターン目に「穴」で準備し、次のターンに7枠広域の「ブーシェ」を資源なしで撃って: A Pierce E.G.O that prepares with Le Trou on the first turn, then on the next turn fires Boucher un trou, a 7-target attack, without resources to gain large amounts of Poise and Charge.
messages.穴(le trou): 戦闘で初めて使うと、精神消耗と必要資源が軽くなる(憂鬱2: **Le Trou**: The first time it is used in a battle, its Sanity cost and requirements are reduced (2 Gloom, 2 Pride, and 2 Envy less). It cannot Clash and does not hit enemies; she gains 5 Ashen Bullet, Poise, Charge, and Black Wings.
messages.ブーシェ: 弾丸があると発動する広域攻撃。攻撃前に弾丸を全消耗して呼吸と充電を得: **Boucher un trou**: A multi-target attack that activates while she has Bullets. Before attacking, she spends all Bullets to gain Poise and Charge, with +8% damage per Bullet. It reuses an Unbreakable Coin (Bullets spent − 1) times, up to 4.
messages.資源なしの再使用: パッシブにより、灰色の弾丸が5なら資源を消耗しない。弾丸はタ: **Reuse without resources**: Through the passive, it spends no resources when she has 5 Ashen Bullet. She gains 1 Bullet each Turn Start, so after firing it, she can fire it again without resources after a set number of turns.
messages.火力の源: 対象が少ないほどダメージ量が増える(解析Ⅳで単体なら+100%)。呼: **Damage source**: Deals more damage the fewer targets there are, +100% against a single target at Threadspin Ⅳ. Poise Potency plus Charge Count also raises Clash Power.
messages.解析Ⅳの支援: ブーシェの攻撃後に、味方2+(最大共鳴数)名(最大7名)へ呼吸を: **Support at Threadspin Ⅳ**: After Boucher un trou's attack, gives Poise to 2 + (highest Resonance) allies, up to 7.
messages.先に「穴」を撃って弾丸を5にし、次のターンに「ブーシェ」で撃つ。: Fire Le Trou first to reach 5 Bullets, then fire Boucher un trou on the next turn.
messages.弾丸が5未満だと効果が弱まり資源も必要になるので、できるだけ5まで溜める。: With fewer than 5 Bullets, its effects weaken and it requires resources, so build up to 5 whenever possible.
messages.呼吸や充電を使う人格の立ち上がりに使える。侵蝕スキルは敵味方識別不可で味方に当た: It helps Identities that use Poise or Charge get started. The Corrosion skill cannot distinguish friend from foe and can hit allies, so Awakening is likely easier to use.
messages.Ⅲ: ブーシェの威力・ダメージ増加・マッチ威力の上限が伸びる。侵蝕スキルにも呼吸: **Ⅲ**: Raises Boucher un trou's power, damage bonus, and Clash Power cap. The Corrosion skill also gains Poise infliction.
messages.Ⅳ: ダメージ増加がさらに伸び、覚醒に味方への呼吸付与が加わる。: **Ⅳ**: Further raises the damage bonus and adds Poise for allies to Awakening.
messages.人差し指遂行者：【紙片】: 呼吸を使う人格で、S2(傲慢)・S3(憂鬱)で必要資: **[The Index Proselyte: 【Paper Slip】](persona:0214)**: A Poise Identity whose S2 (Pride) and S3 (Gloom) supply some of the required affinities.
messages.マルチクラック事務所 代表: S1が充電を消耗、S3が充電を獲得し、S2(嫉妬): **[MultiCrack Office Rep](persona:0210)**: S1 spends Charge and S3 gains Charge, and her S2 (Envy) and S3 (Gloom) also supply some of the required affinities.
